text: This solution, National Flood Risk Data Integration Platform (NFRDIP) addresses natural catastrophe in Philippines between Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT), Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA), National Mapping and Resource Information Authority (NAMRIA), Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH), Local Government Units (LGUs), and Asian Development Bank (ADB). The program was implemented in Cannot be determined and focuses on collaboration and leveraging tech.
